about.title: Raul Naghiyev
about.role: Architect · Engineer · Interior Designer · BIM Expert
about.intro: A 38-year-old international architect, engineer, interior designer, and BIM expert, Raul Naghiyev builds a bridge between Central European design rigor and the emerging markets of the Caucasus. With a Master's degree from BTU Cottbus, Germany, an interior design qualification from the United Kingdom, and an engineering foundation from Azerbaijan, his practice unites technical precision with a refined architectural sensibility across three countries.
standards: SIA — Swiss Society of Engineers and Architects

bim.title: Building Information Modeling & Digital Twin
bim.description: BIM methodology transforms a building into structured, intelligent data — long before the first stone is laid. Every wall, beam, and pipe becomes a coordinated element within a single smart model, enabling clash-free construction, precise cost control, and a living Digital Twin (Rəqəmsal Əkiz) that continues to serve the building throughout its lifecycle.

features.title: Digital Twin
features.description: A living digital replica of the building, synchronized with its physical counterpart across the full lifecycle.

features.title: Collision Detection
features.description: Automated clash analysis across architectural, structural, and MEP disciplines before construction begins.

features.title: Cost Efficiency
features.description: Accurate quantity takeoff and forecasting that reduce waste, rework, and budget overruns.

features.title: Sustainable Design
features.description: Data-driven decisions across energy, material, and lifecycle performance for a lower environmental footprint.
